title: Job Application and CV / Molɔngɔ́nɛ ya mɔkɔlɔ mpé CV
bridge: Na español, tozali kosɛnga 'tengo 25 años' to 'soy graduado en Turismo', kasi na anglais structure ezali mɔkɔlɔ: tozali kosɛnga verbum 'to have' mpé prépositions spécifiques o 'in' to 'from'. Bakisami likambo ya 'experience' (te 'experiences' na contexte général) mpé position ya adjectif libanga na substantif, o anglais ezali likambo ya ndenge. Boya kozonga 'me dedico a' na 'I dedicate myself to', kasi ezali ya molɔngɔ́ ya ngala; na anglais tozali kosɛnga 'I work as' to 'I am responsible for'.
rule: Koti kozwa yango na anglais niveau B1: 1) Sɛnga présent simple koti kozwa yango na travail ya yo ya mɔkɔlɔ: 'I work as a...' (Nazali kosala travail o...), 'I am responsible for...' (Nazali na responsabilité ya...). 2) Po na expérience ya liboso, sɛnga 'used to' to passé simple: 'I used to work at...' / 'I worked at...'. 3) Verbum 'have' tozali kosɛnga yango koti kozwa âge mpé possession ya compétences: 'I have five years of experience' (Nazali na cinq ans ya expérience). 4) Adjectifs ezali libanga na substantif: 'I have strong communication skills' (te 'skills strong'). 5) Sɛnga 'in' po na secteurs ('experience in hospitality'), 'at' po na entreprises ('at a hotel'), mpé 'as' po na postes ('as a manager'). 6) Na CV, tozali kosɛnga puces na verbes na passé to présent, te phrases complètes.

Po na diplômes, tozali kosɛnga 'have a degree in' (na diplôme na). Likɔ́bɔ ya mɔkɔlɔ ezali kozonga 'old' liboso ya âge. Boya: 'I am + número + years old' mpé 'graduate from' to 'have a degree in'.

title: Discussing current events / Kozonga yango na bilili mawa na mawa
bridge: Na espanyolé, tokosala ntango moke na ntango mosúsu mpo na kozonga yango na bilili mawa na mawa, mpe tokosala maboko ya nkwa ya kopesa mawa na mawa lokola 'selon' to 'bakozonga yango'. Na anglais, tokosala ntango moke mpo na bilili mawa na mawa (lokola 'has happened') mpe ntango mosúsu mpo na bilili mawa na mawa oyo ezali na ntango ya solo (lokola 'yesterday'). Mpe, tokosala ntango ya kozala (lokola 'is happening') mingi na anglais mpo na yango oyo ezali kozala. Nsango moko oyo tokoki kosala ezali kopesa yango na ntango moke mpo na bilili mawa na mawa oyo ezali kozala na ntango ya solo, lokola 'está pasando' mpo na 'is happening', kasi na ndenge moko tokosala ntango moke mpo na bilili mawa na mawa oyo ezali kozala na ntango ya solo.
rule: Mpo na kozonga yango na bilili mawa na mawa na anglais na niveau B1: 1. Kosala ntango moke (have/has + participio) mpo na kozonga yango na bilili mawa na mawa oyo ezali kozala na ntango ya solo: 'Scientists have discovered a new planet.' 2. Kosala ntango mosúsu mpo na bilili mawa na mawa oyo ezali na ntango ya solo: 'They announced the result yesterday.' 3. Kosala ntango ya kozala mpo na yango oyo ezali kozala: 'The government is debating the new law.' 4. Mpo na kozonga molongo, kosala maboko ya nkwa lokola 'I think', 'In my opinion', 'I believe' na nsima ya mokolo moko. 5. Maboko ya nkwa ya solo: 'headline', 'article', 'report', 'according to', 'latest', 'issue'.

title: Cultural Differences and Misunderstandings / Bandakáná ya makási mpé malentendidos
bridge: Na español, tozali kosenga makasi mpé kozonga na ndenge moke koleka, kasi na anglais bazali kotosa ndenge ya kozala moke na bosembo mpé na kotiya, lokola 'I think...' to 'Maybe...'. Kosi na anglais, malentendidos bazali kosilika na bilili ya komonisa ete olingi koyeba makasi ( 'Do you mean...?'), kasi na español bazali koleka kokoma to kopesa motoya. Po na kosala ete kuna mabe te, ezali ya makasi koyeba ndenge ya kosenga makasi na kozonga na biso lokola 'What do you mean?' na esika ya kozala na elongo na oyo tozali koyeba. Oyo kozala na esika ya kozala na temps verbal: na anglais bazali kotosa temps passé simple po na actions kozala na esika, kasi na español bazali koleka kotosa temps passé composé po na temps ya liboso.
rule: Po na kozala na ndenge ya kozala na anglais na niveau B1, ezali ya makasi koyeba: 1) Bilili ya kozala moke: 'Could you explain that?' na esika ya 'Explain that'. 2) Kozala na ndenge ya kozala moke: 'I think', 'I feel', 'I guess' po na kozala moke. 3) Bilili ya komonisa ete olingi koyeba makasi: 'Do you mean...?', 'Are you saying...?' po na koyeba oyo loba. 4) Kozala na temps passé simple po na actions kozala na esika: 'I misunderstood' (te 'I have misunderstood' soki ezali na esika ya kozala na présent). Boya kozala na traduction ya 'tener razón' (to be right, te 'to have reason') mpé ya 'hacer falta' (to need, te 'to make lack').

title: Discussing Environmental Topics / Kozonga ntema ya mabotamabotama
bridge: Na español, po na kozonga makambo oyo ezali na koya, tozali kosalela temps présent simple ('contaminamos') to 'presente continuo' ('estamos contaminando') na ndenge nionso. Na anglais, esengo ezali ya motoya: temps présent simple ('we pollute') ekokisa makano to bongo ndenge, mpe temps présent continu ('we are polluting') ekokisa makambo oyo ezali kokoma. Kasi na anglais, po na kozonga makambo oyo tokoki kosala na mbula oyo ezali koza (lokola 'We are going to reduce waste'), tosalela 'be going to' to temps présent continu, kasi na español tosalela temps futur simple ('reduciremos'). Kolinga mpe na motindo ya 'should' po na kopesa makambo oyo tokoki kosala, oyo na español tosalela 'deberíamos'.
rule: Po na kozonga ntema ya mabotamabotama na anglais na niveau B1, boye koleka: 1) Temps présent simple (makano ya bongo ndenge: 'The planet is warming' – kasi na kambo wana tosaleli temps présent continu pamba te ezali processus; po na makano: 'Climate change affects everyone'), 2) Temps présent continu (makambo oyo ezali kokoma: 'Forests are disappearing'), 3) 'be going to' + verbe (makambo oyo tokoki kosala na mbula oyo ezali koza: 'We are going to install solar panels'), mpe 4) 'should' + verbe (makambo oyo tokoki kosala: 'You should recycle more'). Kosepela ete na anglais, temps présent simple ekotakama na '-s' na troisième personne singulier (he/she/it). Po na 'there is/are' (ezali), kosepela ete 'there is' po na singulier, 'there are' po na pluriel. Kosalela mpe bakisi lokola 'because', 'so', 'therefore' po na kobongisa mituno. Kosepela ete na anglais, adjectif ezali liboso ya nom ('renewable energy', kasi te 'energy renewable').

concept_examples.text: We are reducing our carbon footprint by using public transport.
concept_examples.translation: Tozali komitela mbala ya karboni na biso na kosalela mitombo ya transporti ya komonko.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː ɑːr rɪˈdjuːsɪŋ ˈaʊər ˈkɑːrbən ˈfʊtprɪnt baɪ ˈjuːzɪŋ ˈpʌblɪk ˈtrænspɔːrt/

concept_examples.text: Climate change affects everyone, but we can still make a difference.
concept_examples.translation: Boyokani ya clima ekokisa bato nionso, kasi tokoki mpe kobonga lisusu.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈklaɪmət tʃeɪndʒ əˈfɛkts ˈɛvriwʌn, bʌt wiː kæn stɪl meɪk ə ˈdɪfərəns/

concept_examples.text: If we don't act now, the planet will suffer serious consequences.

common_error.wrong: We are recycle the plastic bottles in our house.
common_error.correct: We recycle the plastic bottles in our house.
common_error.correct_alt: We are recycling the plastic bottles in our house.
common_error.explanation: Likolo ezali pamba na esengo kati ya temps présent simple mpe temps présent continu. Na español, 'reciclamos' ekoki kozonga makano to makambo oyo ezali kokoma. Na anglais, soki ezali makano to makano ya ntango nionso, salela temps présent simple ('recycle'); soki ezali makambo oyo ezali kokoma, salela temps présent continu ('are recycling'). Boye kozua 'are recycle' – verbe ya ntina boye kozua na '-ing' na temps continu.

examples.original: Air pollution is a serious problem in many cities.
examples.phonetic: /ɛər pəˈluːʃən ɪz ə ˈsɪriəs ˈprɒbləm ɪn ˈmɛni ˈsɪtiz/
examples.translation: Boyokani ya mibongo ezali likambo mabe mingi na biloko mingi.
examples.note: Salela 'is' po na makano ya bongo ndenge. Kosepela ete 'pollution' ezali nom oyo taeyangaka te, liboso kozua 'a pollution'.

examples.original: The oceans are getting warmer because of climate change.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈoʊʃənz ɑːr ˈɡɛtɪŋ ˈwɔːrmər bɪˈkɒz əv ˈklaɪmət tʃeɪndʒ/
examples.translation: Mibali ezali kopesa motindo pamba na boyokani ya clima.
examples.note: Salela temps présent continu 'are getting' po na kozonga processus oyo ezali kokoma.

examples.original: There is too much plastic waste in the environment.
examples.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz tuː mʌtʃ ˈplæstɪk weɪst ɪn ðə ɪnˈvaɪrənmənt/
examples.translation: Ezali makasi mingi ya plastik na mabotamabotama.
examples.note: Salela 'there is' na nom oyo taeyangaka te lokola 'waste'. Kozua te 'there are waste'.

examples.original: Deforestation destroys the habitat of many animals.
examples.phonetic: /ˌdiːfɒrɪˈsteɪʃən dɪˈstrɔɪz ðə ˈhæbɪtæt əv ˈmɛni ˈænɪməlz/
examples.translation: Kobima ya miti ekoma ndako ya bato mingi.
examples.note: Temps présent simple po na makano ya bongo ndenge. Kosepela na '-s' na troisième personne: 'destroys'.

levels.label: Talking about Solutions and Actions
levels.translation: Kozonga makambo oyo tokoki kosala mpe makambo oyo tokoki kosala

examples.original: We are planting more trees in our neighborhood.
examples.phonetic: /wiː ɑːr ˈplæntɪŋ mɔːr triːz ɪn ˈaʊər ˈneɪbərhʊd/
examples.translation: Tozali kopesa miti mingi na quartier ya biso.
examples.note: Temps présent continu po na makambo oyo ezali kokoma. 'Plant' ekotakama na 'planting'.

examples.original: Our school is going to start a recycling program.
examples.phonetic: /ˈaʊər skuːl ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə stɑːrt ə riːˈsaɪklɪŋ ˈproʊɡræm/
examples.translation: Ecole ya biso ekopesa programme ya kosala makasi lisusu.
examples.note: Salela 'be going to' po na makambo oyo tokoki kosala na mbula oyo ezali koza. Kobima 'is going to' na kozonga ya ndenge ya kati.

examples.original: We should use less electricity to save energy.
examples.phonetic: /wiː ʃʊd juːz lɛs ɪlɛkˈtrɪsɪti tə seɪv ˈɛnərdʒi/
examples.translation: Boye kosalela motuya mingi te po na kosala motuya.
examples.note: 'Should' na verbe ya ntina (kozua te 'to'). 'Less' po na nom oyo taeyangaka te; 'fewer' po na nom oyo taeyangaka.

examples.original: If everyone recycles, we will reduce pollution.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ˈɛvriwʌn riːˈsaɪkəlz, wiː wɪl rɪˈdjuːs pəˈluːʃən/
examples.translation: Soki bato nionso basalela makasi lisusu, tokomitela boyokani.
examples.note: Première condition: 'if' + temps présent simple, 'will' + verbe. 'Everyone' ezali singulier.

levels.label: Expressing Opinions and Making Recommendations
levels.translation: Kozonga mituno na kopesa makambo oyo tokoki kosala

examples.original: I think that electric cars are a good investment for the future.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk ðæt ɪˈlɛktrɪk kɑːrz ɑːr ə ɡʊd ɪnˈvɛstmənt fɔːr ðə ˈfjuːtʃər/
examples.translation: Nakoki koloba ete makasi ya machin ezali makasi ya ntina po na mbula oyo ezali koza.
examples.note: Salela 'I think that' po na mituno. Na nsuka ya 'think', 'that' ezali ya kati.

examples.original: In my opinion, recycling should be mandatory in every city.
examples.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ əˈpɪnjən, riːˈsaɪklɪŋ ʃʊd biː ˈmændətəri ɪn ˈɛvri ˈsɪti/
examples.translation: Na mituno na ngai, kosala makasi lisusu boye kozala ya ndenge nionso na biloko nionso.
examples.note: Kozonga 'in my opinion' + 'should be'. 'Recycling' ezali nom, liboso verbe ezali singulier.

examples.original: The government should invest more in renewable energy sources.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈɡʌvərnmənt ʃʊd ɪnˈvɛst mɔːr ɪn rɪˈnjuːəbəl ˈɛnərdʒi ˈsɔːrsɪz/
examples.translation: Gouvernement boye kopesa motuya mingi na makasi ya motuya oyo taeyangaka te.
examples.note: Makambo oyo tokoki kosala na 'should'. Adjectif 'renewable' ezali liboso ya nom.

examples.original: If we don't stop deforestation, many species will become extinct.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wiː doʊnt stɒp ˌdiːfɒrɪˈsteɪʃən, ˈmɛni ˈspiːʃiːz wɪl bɪˈkʌm ɪkˈstɪŋkt/
examples.translation: Soki tokoma kobima ya miti te, bato mingi bakotambola.
examples.note: Condition ya ntango 1 na 'if we don't'. 'Species' ezali singulier mpe pluriel.

title: Talking About Technology and Social Media / Kozwa yango lokola ntango technology na social media
bridge: Na español, tolingi kopesa mbala moke ntango mosusu mpo na kozwa habitude mpe mpo na action oyo ezali komipepeka (lokola 'ahora mismo estoy viendo el celular'), kasi na anglais, esengo eyei kati ya ntango mosusu mpe ntango oyo ezali komipepeka ezali ya molimu. Mpe, ntango otalelaka technology, bato oyo bayekolaka español bazali kopesa mbala moke ba structure lokola 'tengo que hacer click' to 'me gusta la foto', kasi na anglais bazali koyeba 'I have to click' to 'I like the photo' na kozonga pronombre me. Kolinga motuya na ba phrasal verbs (lokola 'log in', 'sign up') oyo bazali na esengo eyei na español mpe bazali koyekola na verbe moko.
rule: Mpo na kozwa yango lokola ntango technology na social media na niveau B1, kozala na: 1) Ntango mosusu mpo na habitude na état (I check my phone every morning). 2) Ntango oyo ezali komipepeka mpo na action oyo ezali komipepeka (I am scrolling through Instagram right now). 3) Ba verbe modaux mpo na suggestion na capacité: can, should, must (You should update your password). 4) Ba phrasal verbs ya ntango: log in, log out, sign up, turn on, turn off, set up. 5) Ba expressions na 'like' na 'share' (I like the post, She shared the video). Koyeba ete na anglais bazali kozonga article liboso ya 'social media' (I spend time on social media, kasi 'in the social media'). Mpe, mpo na kopesa possession na ba appareils, bazali koyeba 'have' (I have a new phone) mpe bazali kozonga 'tengo' na esengo ya 'there is'.

concept_examples.text: I usually check my social media in the morning.
concept_examples.translation: Normalement nakoki kozwa ba rézo sosio na ngai na likolo.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli tʃek maɪ ˈsoʊʃl ˈmiːdiə ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: She is posting a story on Instagram right now.
concept_examples.translation: Ye azali kopesa yango lokola histoire na Instagram awuti awuti.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃi ɪz ˈpoʊstɪŋ ə ˈstɔːri ɑːn ˈɪnstəɡræm raɪt naʊ/

concept_examples.text: You should log out of your account on public computers.
concept_examples.translation: Ozali koyeba kobima session na compte na yo na ba ordinateur ya publique.
concept_examples.phonetic: /juː ʃʊd lɔːɡ aʊt əv jʊər əˈkaʊnt ɑːn ˈpʌblɪk kəmˈpjuːtərz/

concept_examples.text: Can you help me set up my new laptop?
concept_examples.translation: Oyebi kosalisa ngai mpo na kosala paramètre na laptop ya ngai ya sika?
concept_examples.phonetic: /kæn juː hɛlp miː sɛt ʌp maɪ nuː ˈlæptɑːp/

common_error.wrong: I am agree with you about social media.
common_error.correct: I agree with you about social media.
common_error.correct_alt: I agree on that point about social media.
common_error.explanation: Na español tozali koyeba 'estoy de acuerdo', kasi na anglais 'agree' ezali verbe ya état mpe bazali kozonga koyeba yango na forme ya ntango oyo ezali komipepeka. Mpo na kozala na esengo eyei, koyeba ete 'agree' ezali kozonga 'be' liboso. Erreur moko ya ntango ezali koyeba 'I am agree', kasi esengo eyei ezali 'I agree'. Oyebi mpe koyeba 'I agree with you' (nazali de acuerdo na yo) to 'I agree on that' (nazali de acuerdo na yango).

levels.label: Basic Vocabulary and Phrases for Tech
levels.translation: Vocabulaire ya mawa mpe ba phrases mpo na technologie

examples.original: I need to charge my phone.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ niːd tə tʃɑːrdʒ maɪ foʊn/
examples.translation: Nazali na besoin ya kobimisa téléphone na ngai.
examples.note: Verbe 'charge' esengo ezali kobimisa (baterie). Na español tozali moke koyeba 'cargar' mpo na téléphone, kasi na anglais bazali kozonga koyeba 'load' na contexte oyo.

examples.original: My laptop is very slow.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ ˈlæptɑːp ɪz ˈvɛri sloʊ/
examples.translation: Laptop na ngai ezali ya motuya ya sika.
examples.note: Koyeba ete na anglais 'slow' bazali koyeba mpo na vitesse ya ordinateur, lokola na español, kasi kozonga kozala na esengo eyei na 'late' (tarde).

examples.original: Do you have a charger?
examples.phonetic: /duː juː hæv ə ˈtʃɑːrdʒər/
examples.translation: Ozali na chargeur?
examples.note: Question ya ntango na ba conversation. Koyeba ete 'charger' esengo ezali chargeur, kasi 'loader'.

examples.original: I'm scrolling through my feed.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈskroʊlɪŋ θruː maɪ fiːd/
examples.translation: Nazali kozwa ba feed na ngai.
examples.note: Phrasal verb 'scroll through' bazali koyeba mpo na kozwa écran. Na español tozali koyeba 'deslizar' to 'hacer scroll', kasi na anglais bazali koyeba 'scroll' lokola verbe.

examples.original: She uploaded a new video yesterday.
examples.phonetic: /ʃi ʌpˈloʊdɪd ə nuː ˈvɪdioʊ ˈjɛstərdeɪ/
examples.translation: Ye apesi yango lokola vidéo ya sika awuti.
examples.note: Na anglais 'upload' bazali koyeba mpo na kopesa contenu; na español tozali moke koyeba 'subir' kasi mpe 'montar' na ba dialecte mosusu. Awa tozali koyeba passé simple.

examples.original: He liked my post and commented.
examples.phonetic: /hiː laɪkt maɪ poʊst ænd ˈkɑːmɛntɪd/
examples.translation: Ye alingaki publication na ngai mpe apesi commentaire.
examples.note: Koyeba ete na anglais bazali koyeba 'he liked' (kasi 'he liked it' soki ezali koyeba) mpe verbe 'like' ezali kozonga pronombre indirect lokola na español 'le gustó'.

examples.original: Are you following that influencer?
examples.phonetic: /ɑːr juː ˈfɑːloʊɪŋ ðæt ˈɪnfluənsər/
examples.translation: Ozali kozwa influencer oyo?
examples.note: Verbe 'follow' bazali koyeba na ba rézo sosio. Na español tozali moke koyeba 'seguir' mpe, kasi na anglais ezali lokola. Koyeba esengo ya ntango oyo ezali komipepeka mpo na question.

levels.label: Discussing Pros and Cons of Social Media
levels.translation: Kozwa ba pour na ba contre ya ba rézo sosio

examples.original: Social media can be addictive.
examples.phonetic: /ˈsoʊʃl ˈmiːdiə kæn biː əˈdɪktɪv/
examples.translation: Ba rézo sosio bazali koyeba na addiction.
examples.note: Tozali koyeba modal 'can' mpo na possibilité. Na español tozali koyeba 'pueden ser', kasi na anglais verbe modal ezali kozonga kobonga selon personne.

examples.original: One advantage is that you can connect with people worldwide.
examples.phonetic: /wʌn ədˈvæntɪdʒ ɪz ðæt juː kæn kəˈnɛkt wɪð ˈpiːpəl ˈwɜːrldwaɪd/
examples.translation: Avantage moko ezali ete oyebi kozwa na bato na mokili mobimba.
examples.note: Awa tozali koyeba 'one advantage' mpo na kopesa point ya pour. Na español tozali koyeba 'una ventaja es que', kasi na anglais structure ezali lokola.

examples.original: However, it can waste a lot of time.
examples.phonetic: /haʊˈɛvər, ɪt kæn weɪst ə lɑːt əv taɪm/
examples.translation: Kasi, ezali koyeba na temps mingi.
examples.note: Mot 'however' ezali conector ya ntango. Na español tozali koyeba 'sin embargo'. Koyeba ete 'waste' esengo ezali koboma, kasi kozonga 'spend' (kobimisa temps).

examples.original: I think it's better to limit screen time.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk ɪts ˈbɛtər tə ˈlɪmɪt skriːn taɪm/
examples.translation: Nazali koyeba ete ezali mawa mpo na kobima temps ya écran.
examples.note: Tozali koyeba 'it's better to' + infinitif mpo na kopesa recommandation. Na español tozali koyeba 'es mejor que limites', kasi na anglais bazali koyeba 'to limit'.

title: Talking about Education and Studying Abroad / Mokolo ya kelasi na kosala kelasi ekoló
bridge: Na nsukani ya español, mpo na kosolola ntango oyo ezali kokóma, tosilaka ntango oyo ezali na esika na ntango oyo ezali kokóma (nazali kosala kelasi, nazali kokóma), kasi na anglais ezali pete mpenza kosalaka ntango oyo ezali na esika na ntango oyo ezali kokóma (I am studying) tango plan ezali na esika. Kosi na elongo ete na anglais tokolakaka 'I have 20 years' kasi 'I am 20 years old'. Na kosolola kelasi, tokoki komona ete liboso ya yango na domaine ya kelasi ezali na article defini na anglais ('I study mathematics'), kasi na español ezali na yango ('Estudio las matemáticas'). Koluka na bango yango mpo na kosolola malamu.
rule: Mpo na kosolola mokolo ya kelasi na kosala kelasi ekoló na anglais na niveau B1, kosalaka: 1. Ntango oyo ezali na esika mpo na bango na routine ('I study every day'). 2. Ntango oyo ezali kokóma mpo na actions oyo ezali na esika ('I am studying for my exam') na mpo na plan oyo ezali na esika ('I am going to England next month'). 3. 'Going to' mpo na intentions ('I'm going to apply for a scholarship'). 4. 'Will' mpo na décisions ya motuya na prédictions ('I think it will be a great experience'). 5. Verbes modaux koti 'can', 'must', 'should' mpo na capacités, obligations na conseils ('You should apply early'). 6. Prépositions: 'study at a university', 'apply for a course', 'major in' (kobondela na), 'take an exam'. 7. Liboso ya yango ya matières ya kelasi ezali na article ('I like history'). 8. Kosalaka 'abroad' (ekoló) ezali na préposition, kasi 'to study abroad' to 'study abroad' koti verbe to substantif.

concept_examples.text: I am studying English in London next year.
concept_examples.translation: Nazali kokóma kosala kelasi ya anglais na Londres mobu oyo ezali kokóma.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈstʌdiɪŋ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ɪn ˈlʌndən nekst jɪər/

concept_examples.text: She wants to major in Biology at a Canadian university.
concept_examples.translation: Ye azali na elingo kobondela na Biologie na université ya Kanada.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃi wɒnts tə ˈmeɪdʒər ɪn baɪˈɒlədʒi æt ə kəˈneɪdiən ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti/

concept_examples.text: You should apply for a scholarship early.
concept_examples.translation: Ozali koyeba kolinga mbongo ya kelasi ntango ya liboso.
concept_examples.phonetic: /juː ʃʊd əˈplaɪ fɔːr ə ˈskɒləʃɪp ˈɜːrli/

concept_examples.text: We are going to study abroad next semester.
concept_examples.translation: Tokokóma kosala kelasi ekoló mobu oyo ezali kokóma.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː ˈɑːr ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈstʌdi əˈbrɔːd nekst sɪˈmestər/

common_error.wrong: I have 20 years and I study in the university.
common_error.correct: I am 20 years old and I study at the university.
common_error.correct_alt: I am 20 and I attend university.
common_error.explanation: Lifuta 'I have 20 years' ezali traduction ya motuya ya español 'tengo 20 años'. Na anglais tosalaka verbe 'to be' na ndako ya âge: 'I am 20 years old'. Kosi na elongo ete na anglais tokolakaka 'study at the university' (kasi 'in the university') mpo na kosalaka 'at' mpo na institutions. Koluka na bango yango mpo na kozonga lifuta oyo ezali pete mpenza.

examples.original: I am a student at a university in Madrid.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ æm ə ˈstuːdənt æt ə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ɪn məˈdrɪd/
examples.translation: Nazali mwana kelasi na université na Madrid.
examples.note: Kosalaka 'at' mpo na komonisa esika oyo ozali kosala kelasi, kasi 'in'.

examples.original: I am studying law this year.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈstʌdiɪŋ lɔː ðɪs jɪər/
examples.translation: Nazali kosala kelasi ya droit mobu oyo ezali na esika.
examples.note: Ntango oyo ezali kokóma mpo na action oyo ezali na esika. Liboso ya yango ya matières na domaine ya kelasi ezali na article.

examples.original: My major is Psychology.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ ˈmeɪdʒər ɪz saɪˈkɒlədʒi/
examples.translation: Domaine na ngai ezali Psychologie.
examples.note: 'Major' ezali mpo na kobondela na université na Etats-Unis.

levels.label: Future plans and intentions
levels.translation: Plan na intentions oyo ezali kokóma

examples.original: I'm going to study abroad next month.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈstʌdi əˈbrɔːd nekst mʌnθ/
examples.translation: Nazali kokóma kosala kelasi ekoló mobu oyo ezali kokóma.
examples.note: 'Going to' ezali mpo na komonisa intention to plan oyo ezali na esika.

examples.original: She is going to take an English course in Dublin.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə teɪk ən ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ kɔːrs ɪn ˈdʌblɪn/
examples.translation: Ye azali kokóma kosala kelasi ya anglais na Dublin.
examples.note: 'Take a course' ezali expression oyo ezali pete mpenza; 'carry out' ezali na yango.

examples.original: We will apply for a student visa soon.
examples.phonetic: /wiː wɪl əˈplaɪ fɔːr ə ˈstuːdənt ˈviːzə suːn/
examples.translation: Tokokóma kolinga visa ya mwana kelasi ntango ya liboso.
examples.note: 'Will' ezali mpo na décisions to promesses oyo ezali kokóma, ntango mosusu ezali na esika mingi koleka 'going to'.

levels.label: Advice and opinions about studying abroad
levels.translation: Conseils na avis mpo na kosala kelasi ekoló

examples.original: You should research the university before you apply.
examples.phonetic: /juː ʃʊd rɪˈsɜːrtʃ ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti bɪˈfɔːr juː əˈplaɪ/
examples.translation: Ozali koyeba koluka université liboso ya kolinga.
examples.note: Kosalaka 'should' mpo na komema conseil.

examples.original: It is important to practice English every day.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɪmˈpɔːrtənt tə ˈpræktɪs ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈevri deɪ/
examples.translation: Ezali ya ndenge mpo na kosala anglais ntango nyonso.
examples.note: Structure 'It is + adjective + to + verb' ezali pete mpenza mpo na avis.

examples.original: Studying abroad can be a life-changing experience.
examples.phonetic: /ˈstʌdiɪŋ əˈbrɔːd kæn biː ə laɪf ˈtʃeɪndʒɪŋ ɪkˈspɪəriəns/
examples.translation: Kosala kelasi ekoló ezali kokóma expérience oyo ezali kobimisa ndako.
examples.note: Kosalaka 'can' mpo na komonisa possibilité. Gerundif ('studying') ezali mpo na sujet.

examples.original: I think you should go for it.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk juː ʃʊd ɡoʊ fɔːr ɪt/
examples.translation: Nazali koyeba ete ozali koyeba kosala yango.
examples.note: Expression 'go for it' ezali mpo na kozwa mwana kelasi mpo na kosala yango.

translations.ln: Mokolo ya kelasi na kosala kelasi ekoló

title: Talking about Past Trips and Travel Experiences / Kozonga yango lokola misato mpe bangomba ya mokolo na mokolo
bridge: Na espanyol, po kozonga bangomba ya mokolo na mokolo, tosilanga na bango temps passé composé mpe temps passé simple, mpe elongo kati na 'he viajado' mpe 'viajé' ezali na ntina na contexte ya temps. Na anglais, elongo oyo ezali mpona bango, kasi na bangogo malamu: present perfect (have + participe passé) tosilanga po bangomba oyo ezali na mokolo moko te, mpe past simple (viajé) tosilanga po bangomba oyo salemi na mokolo moko ya mokolo na mokolo. Molongo moko ezali kozala na past simple na esika ya present perfect soki totunaka '¿Has estado alguna vez...?', pona na espanyol tosilanga 'has estado' kasi na anglais tosilanga 'have you ever been'. Kosi na anglais, bangogo ya mabe lokola 'go/went/gone' mpe 'see/saw/seen' ezali na ntina ya koyekola, mpe bato ya espanyol bazali kozua 'been' mpe 'gone' na esika moko: 'have been' elobeli 'koya mpe kobimisa', mpe 'have gone' elobeli 'azali awa awa'.
rule: Po kozonga bangomba ya misato na anglais na niveau B1, ozali na bosungi ya kozala na bango temps present perfect (have/has + participe passé) mpe past simple (verbe na passé). Usa present perfect po: 1) bangomba ya bomoi oyo ezali na mokolo moko te (I have visited Paris), 2) na bangogo lokola 'ever', 'never', 'already', 'yet' (Have you ever been to Japan?), 3) bangomba oyo balingi na mokolo na mokolo (I have lived here for three years). Usa past simple po: 1) bangomba oyo salemi na mokolo moko ya mokolo na mokolo (I visited Paris last summer), 2) na bangogo ya temps lokola 'yesterday', 'in 2019', 'last week', 'when I was a child'. Bangogo ya mabe ya misato: go-went-gone, see-saw-seen, eat-ate-eaten, take-took-taken, fly-flew-flown, ride-rode-ridden, drive-drove-driven, stay-stayed-stayed (ya ntango nyonso). Structure ya botuna na present perfect: Have/Has + sujet + participe? (Have you ever flown first class?). Biloko ya kokwela: Yes, I have / No, I haven't. Na past simple: Did + sujet + verbe base? (Did you go to the beach?). Biloko ya kokwela: Yes, I did / No, I didn't. Na 'ever' mpe 'never' tosilanga present perfect, te past simple: 'I have never been to Mexico' (te 'I never went to Mexico' soki ezali bangomba ya bomoi). Usa 'since' na esika ya mokolo moko te (I have visited Spain since 2018 - ezali mabe soki ezali kozala), usa 'since' na esika ya bangomba oyo ezali kozala (I have been in Spain since 2018). Yambula ete bangogo ya molongo (amazing, terrible, wonderful, boring) tosilanga na 'was/were' na past simple po kozonga misato.

title: Talking about habits and routines / Kozonga ntalo na mikakatiko
bridge: Na español, tozali kozonga ntalo na mikakatiko na présent simple, kaka na anglais, kasi ezali bikoki ya ntina mingi: na anglais, présent simple ezali na bosungi ya 'do/does' mpo na kozonga ntalo ya ngala na mpo na kosenga, kasi na español tozali kozonga 'no' to kozonga mbongo ya zoba te. Kosi na maye mazali kosalema na ntango (always, usually, etc.) kozali kokotisa yango liboso ya motuna ya zoba, kasi sima ya zoba 'to be', maye mazali kosalema te na español. Kolinga motema na 's' ya moto ya moke (he/she/it), oyo ezali pona kolandela na yango mpo na bato ya español.
rule: Mpo na kozonga ntalo na mikakatiko na anglais, tozali kozonga présent simple. Mpo na moto moke ya moko (he, she, it), tozali kokota -s to -es na zoba (p. ex., 'works', 'goes'). Mpo na kozonga ntalo ya ngala, tozali kozonga 'do not' (don't) to 'does not' (doesn't) + zoba na ndakisa ya zoba. Mpo na kosenga, tozali kozonga 'do' to 'does' na liboso, sima ya moto na zoba na ndakisa ya zoba. Maye mazali kosalema na ntango (always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never) kozali kokotisa yango: (1) liboso ya zoba ya motuna (I always drink coffee), (2) sima ya zoba 'to be' (He is always late), na (3) kati ya bosungi na zoba na kosenga na kozonga ntalo ya ngala (Do you often exercise?). Bandakisa: na 'have' kaka zoba ya motuna, tozali kozonga 'have/has' (I have breakfast at 8). Na 'go' na 'do', moto moke azali kozonga 'goes' na 'does'. Mpo na mikakatiko ya kozala na ntango ya kozala, kozonga te présent simple; kozonga présent continu.

title: Making Plans and Invitations / Kɔbɔla mitɛndɛ na kosɛnga bɑ̌
bridge: Na ɪŋgele, po kɔbɔla mitɛndɛ na kosɛnga bɑ̌, tosilaka mbala mbala lokuta oyo eteani 'would you like to...?' to 'how about...?', oyo esilaka te na ndakisa ya mobɔkɔlɔ na espanye. Kaka mpe na mbala mosusu, basɛnga mibali oyo eteani 'hang out' oyo ezali na ntina mingi na mibɛlɛ ya kosɛnga oyo ezali ya mawa. Kɛlɛ na esika oyo ɪŋgele esalaka ntina na temps présent progressif po mitɛndɛ ya mokolo oyo kokɔmɛ (I'm meeting), espanye mbala mosusu esalaka ntina na temps présent simple (Quedo).
rule: Po kosɛnga bɑ̌, tosilaka: 'Would you like to + verbe?' (ya mawa) to 'Do you want to + verbe?' (ya mawa te). Po kosala makasi: 'How about + gerundif?' to 'What about + gerundif?'. Po kokaba: 'Sure', 'Sounds good', 'I'd love to'. Po kopɛsa: 'I'm afraid I can't', 'Sorry, I have other plans'. Po mitɛndɛ ya mokolo oyo kokɔmɛ, tosilaka temps présent progressif (I'm meeting my friends tomorrow) to 'going to' (I'm going to visit my sister). Verbe 'hang out' eleki kobanga na bangɛndɛ na mayele. Kɛlɛ na kozonga kozonga te '¿Quedamos?' na 'Are we staying?', oyo ezali ya semba ezali 'Shall we meet?' to 'Let's meet up'.

title: Giving a short presentation / Koma eloko moke
bridge: Na espanyole, tozali kopesa ba mabotami na nzela moke mpenza mpe na makombo oyo ezali ya motuya. Na anglais, mpo na kopesa eloko moke na nzela ya mawa mpe ya motuya, bazali kosenga mabotami oyo ezali ndenge mpe makombo oyo ezali ya motuya. Molongo moko oyo ezali ya ntina ezali ete na anglais bazali kosenga temps présent mpo na kozongisa yango mpe 'going to' to 'will' mpo na mikapo ya solo, mpe na espanyole, mbala mosusu tozali kosenga temps présent to temps futur na makombo oyo ezali ya ndenge moke. Kasi, makombo oyo ezali ya ndenge na anglais (ndakisa 'firstly', 'in addition', 'to sum up') ezali ya ntina mpo na kosala kombo ya kombo, mpe na espanyole tozali kopesa makombo oyo ezali ya ndenge koleka (ndakisa 'en primer lugar', 'además', 'para resumir').
rule: Mpo na kombo moke na anglais, zonga yango na nzela ya mawa: 1) Koma salut mpe kozongisa eloko (ndakisa, 'Good morning, I'm going to talk about...'), 2) Koma mabotami na makombo oyo ezali ya motuya (firstly, secondly, in addition, however), 3) Koma conclusion (to conclude, in summary). Senga temps présent mpo na yango mpe 'going to' to 'will' mpo na mikapo to makengo. Boya kozala na ndenge oyo ezali ya motuya mpe kopesa mabotami oyo ezali ya motuya. Makombo mpe kozala na ye oyo ozali kozala na yango ezali ya ntina, kasi na mabotami, kopesa mabotami oyo ezali ya ndenge (ndakisa 'Let me start by...', 'Moving on to...', 'To wrap up...').

concept_examples.text: Firstly, recycling helps reduce waste in our cities.

concept_examples.text: In addition, it saves energy and natural resources.
concept_examples.translation: Kasi, ezali kosala mpo na kopesa yango moke na nzela ya mawa mpe mpo na kopesa yango moke na nzela ya mawa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪn əˈdɪʃən ɪt seɪvz ˈenərdʒi ənd ˈnætʃrəl ˈriːsɔːrsɪz/

concept_examples.text: To conclude, we all should recycle more to protect the planet.
concept_examples.translation: Mpo na kozonga yango, tozali kosenga kopesa yango moke mpo na kopesa yango moke na nzela ya mawa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /tə kənˈkluːd wi ɔːl ʃʊd rɪˈsaɪkl mɔːr tə prəˈtekt ðə ˈplænɪt/

common_error.wrong: Good morning, I going to talk about the recycling.
common_error.correct: Good morning, I'm going to talk about recycling.
common_error.correct_alt: Good morning, I'm going to talk about the importance of recycling.
common_error.explanation: Soki ozali na eloko oyo ezali ya motuya, ezali mpo na kopesa yango moke na nzela ya mawa. Na anglais, bazali kosenga 'to be' na temps présent ('I am') liboso ya 'going to'. Kasi, na anglais, bazali kosenga 'the' liboso ya yango moke (tozali kozonga yango moke na nzela ya mawa). Mpo na kozala na yango moke, senga 'am/is/are' mpe boya kozala na 'the' liboso ya yango moke.

examples.original: Good morning, everyone.
examples.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmɔːrnɪŋ ˈevriwʌn/
examples.translation: Mbote na bino nyonso.
examples.note: Salut oyo ezali ya motuya mpo na kombo ya kombo. Ezali ya ntina kozala na 'everyone' mpo na kozala na yango moke.

examples.original: I'd like to start by talking about...
examples.phonetic: /aɪd laɪk tə stɑːrt baɪ ˈtɔːkɪŋ əbaʊt/
examples.translation: Nazali na seko ya kozonga yango moke na ntina ya...
examples.note: Mbotami oyo ezali ya motuya mpo na kozonga eloko. Bazali kosenga 'I'd like' mpo na kozala na yango moke.

examples.original: Let me begin with a quick introduction.
examples.phonetic: /let mi bɪˈɡɪn wɪð ə kwɪk ˌɪntrəˈdʌkʃən/
examples.translation: Boyeki nazala na kozonga yango moke na nzela ya mawa.
examples.note: Mbotami moke mpo na kozonga yango moke. 'Let me' ezali kosala 'boyeki', ezali ndenge moke mpe ya motuya.

examples.original: Firstly, let's look at the benefits.
examples.phonetic: /ˈfɜːrstli lets lʊk æt ðə ˈbenɪfɪts/
examples.translation: Na liboso, tozali na yango moke.
examples.note: Kozala na 'firstly' mpo na kozonga eloko ya liboso. Ezali ya motuya koleka 'first'.

examples.original: Secondly, I want to mention some challenges.
examples.phonetic: /ˈsekəndli aɪ wɑːnt tə ˈmenʃən sʌm ˈtʃælɪndʒɪz/
examples.translation: Na zomi, nazali na seko ya kozonga yango moke.
examples.note: Bazali kosenga 'secondly' mpo na eloko ya zomi. Zonga kombo ya yango moke na nzela ya mawa.

examples.original: Another important point is that...
examples.phonetic: /əˈnʌðər ɪmˈpɔːrtənt pɔɪnt ɪz ðæt/
examples.translation: Eloko moke oyo ezali ya ntina ezali ete...
examples.note: Mbotami moke mpo na kozonga yango moke. Ezali ya ntina mpo na kozala na yango moke.

examples.original: However, we must consider the costs.
examples.phonetic: /haʊˈevər wi mʌst kənˈsɪdər ðə kɔːsts/
examples.translation: Kasi, tozali na seko ya kozonga yango moke.
examples.note: 'However' ezali kozonga eloko oyo ezali ya ndenge moke. Na espanyole tozali kosenga 'sin embargo', oyo ezali ndenge moke.

levels.label: Closing and concluding
levels.translation: Kozonga yango moke mpe kozonga yango moke

examples.original: In conclusion, I'd like to summarize the main points.
examples.phonetic: /ɪn kənˈkluːʒən aɪd laɪk tə ˈsʌməraɪz ðə meɪn pɔɪnts/
examples.translation: Mpo na kozonga yango moke, nazali na seko ya kozonga yango moke.
examples.note: Mbotami ya motuya mpo na kozonga yango moke. 'In conclusion' ezali ya motuya, kasi tozali kosenga 'to sum up' na yango moke.

examples.original: To wrap up, remember that every small action counts.
examples.phonetic: /tə ræp ʌp rɪˈmembər ðæt ˈevri smɔːl ˈækʃən kaʊnts/
examples.translation: Mpo na kozonga yango moke, boyeki kozala na seko ya kozonga yango moke.
examples.note: 'To wrap up' ezali mbotami oyo ezali ya motuya mpe ya ndenge moke mpo na kozonga yango moke. Zonga yango na yango moke.

examples.original: Thank you for your attention.
examples.phonetic: /θæŋk ju fɔːr jʊər əˈtenʃən/
examples.translation: Matondo mpo na kozala na yango moke.
examples.note: Matondo ya motuya mpo na kozonga yango moke. Na anglais bazali kosenga 'your attention' (kozala na yango moke), boya 'your time' na yango moke.
